get_logger: get a named logger for the huggingface_hub library with optional custom name
get_verbosity: get the current logging level for the huggingface_hub root logger
set_verbosity: set the logging level for the huggingface_hub root logger to a specified verbosity
set_verbosity_debug: set the huggingface_hub logging verbosity to DEBUG level for detailed output
disable_propagation: disable propagation of huggingface_hub log outputs to parent loggers
